evidenceLedger.verified: Blindspot accepts a public post or video link, checks claims and missing context, and returns a cited report with the short answer first and receipts underneath.

Report dated 22 Aug 2026: OMC ethanol-plant setups are confirmed, while one-day output, 364-days-idle, forced outside buying, and politician-owned supplier claims remain unsupported. The report records one true and seven unchecked claims.
Report dated 14 Aug 2026: footage from the 23 July 2026 Congress-BJP clash in Ranchi was recirculated as current Jharkhand student-protest footage.
Report dated 14 Aug 2026: Champat Rai's quote calling Modi an avatar of Lord Vishnu is from 2023, not a new June-July 2026 event.
Report dated 21 Aug 2026: Ashutosh Ranka issued the reported ultimatum as CJP co-convenor and spokesperson; the reel's Chief Justice title is false.
Report dated 18 Aug 2026: 198 is a Jio complaint number; no source shows that leaving a call to 198 running creates or improves network access.
Report dated 15 Aug 2026: several project incidents are real, but no source confirms the viral aggregate of Rs 34,343 crore or the systemic waste label.

The Ministry of Cooperation annexure says some cooperative sugar-mill ethanol plants cannot operate at full capacity year-round because of feedstock constraints and proposes conversion to multi-feed units. It does not establish 364 days of idleness for listed OMC plants.
Google documents image search by upload, drag-and-drop, image URL, or right-click Search with Google Lens; results can include similar images and websites carrying the image.
C2PA says provenance may describe origin and edits and provide tamper-evident assertions, but provenance can be incomplete and cannot by itself establish that depicted content is true or factual.
